Stage.description:
IFRS 9 impairment stage for a credit exposure.

Under IFRS 9, financial instruments are classified into three stages that
determine the ECL measurement horizon:

- **Stage 1**: 12-month ECL (no significant increase in credit risk)
- **Stage 2**: Lifetime ECL (significant increase in credit risk detected)
- **Stage 3**: Lifetime ECL (credit-impaired, objective evidence of default)

# References

IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, Section 5.5 -- Impairment. `docs/REFERENCES.md#ifrs-9-impairment`

oneOf.description:
Performing -- 12-month ECL. No significant increase in credit risk
since initial recognition.

Underperforming -- lifetime ECL. Significant increase in credit risk
(SICR) detected but not yet credit-impaired.

Non-performing -- lifetime ECL. Credit-impaired (objective evidence of
default: DPD >= 90, restructuring, etc.).

description: Inputs for probability-weighted ECL from cumulative-PD schedules.

bucket_width_years.description:
Optional ECL integration-bucket width in years; `None` uses the
canonical IFRS 9 policy default.

ead.description: Exposure at default in the exposure's base currency.

ead_schedule.description:
Optional exposure-at-default profile represented as
`(time_years, ead)` knots.

eir.description: Annual effective interest rate as a decimal used for discounting.

exposure_id.description: Stable identifier copied into the calculation result.

lgd.description: Loss given default as a decimal probability in `[0, 1]`.

remaining_maturity_years.description: Remaining contractual or behavioural maturity in years.

scenarios.description:
Probability-weighted scenarios represented as `(weight, schedule)`;
each schedule contains `(time_years, cumulative_pd)` knots.

stage.description: Assigned IFRS 9 stage controlling the 12-month or lifetime horizon.

stage3_time_to_recovery_years.description:
Optional Stage 3 expected-recovery horizon in years; `None` uses the
canonical IFRS 9 ECL default.
